title: Why A Third Of America Is Now Tattooed
hook: Tattoos used to be a warning sign. Now they're just Tuesday.
closing: Tattoos stopped being rebellion once a third of America had one. That's just normal now.
question: How many tattoos do you have?

segments.say: In 2006, just 16 percent of Americans had a tattoo. Today that has doubled, to roughly one in three.
Women are even further along: 37 percent have a tattoo, pulling the whole average up with them.
And once people start, they keep going -- one in five Americans now has more than one tattoo.
